profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR. Its website presents it as a developer of self-driving freight technology built around the Aurora Driver, which the company describes as combining hardware and software backed by what it calls verifiable AI, and as a way to integrate autonomy into existing fleets. The site frames the work as delivering the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site carries several partner testimonials. One describes early results from a pilot program that autonomously hauled freight between Fort Worth and El Paso, and another refers to the Aurora Driver being integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. A third states that freight volumes are projected to grow five fold between 2010-2050, and a fourth says the self-driving system has performed over millions of autonomous miles. The company describes its own approach as transparent and safety-focused.

Corporate records list Aurora Innovation as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001828108. Its law exposure is listed in Pennsylvania, with a count of 154. No products, MCP servers, or court cases are recorded for it.
